user.title: TCL Air Conditioner
user.description: Choose how to connect to the TCL+ cloud. Log in with your TCL+ account to get tokens automatically (they refresh themselves), or paste a token captured from the app manually.

menu_options.existing_account: Add a device from an existing account
menu_options.login_password: Log in with account and password
menu_options.login_sms: Log in with SMS verification code

login_password.title: TCL+ account login
login_password.description: Log in with your TCL+ account. The password is hashed before being sent.

login_sms.title: SMS login
login_sms.description: Enter your mobile number to receive a verification code.

sms_code.title: Enter verification code
sms_code.description: Enter the SMS code you received.

device.description: Login succeeded. Choose a discovered AC device. If no devices were discovered, enter the device TID and JIDs manually.

data.enable_fan_only_mode: Enable experimental Fan Only HVAC mode

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate TCL+
reauth_confirm.description: Your TCL+ session expired. Log in again to refresh access.

reauth.title: Re-authenticate TCL+
reauth.description: Choose how to restore your expired TCL+ session.

menu_options.reauth_confirm: Log in with account and password
menu_options.reauth_sms: Log in with SMS verification code

reauth_sms.title: Re-authenticate by SMS
reauth_sms.description: Enter your mobile number to receive a verification code.

reauth_sms_code.title: Enter verification code
reauth_sms_code.description: Enter the SMS code you received to restore access.

manual.description: Set up a TCL air conditioner using local UDP control and optional TCL+ cloud fallback. Cloud access tokens expire; refresh them from a new TCL+ capture when cloud requests start failing.

data.enable_fan_only_mode: Enable experimental Fan Only HVAC mode

advanced.description: Advanced local UDP and TCL+ cloud headers captured from the TCL+ app. Keep these defaults unless you are refreshing a known working capture.

existing_account.title: Existing TCL+ account
existing_account.description: Choose a loaded account. Its saved refresh token is used; no password is stored.

existing_device.title: Add account device
existing_device.description: Choose an AC that is not configured yet. Device identity and current account metadata are saved in a separate entry.

data.enable_fan_only_mode: Enable experimental Fan Only HVAC mode

error.invalid_auth: Login failed: incorrect account, password, or code.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the TCL+ service. Try again.
error.account_not_loaded: The selected account must be loaded before its device inventory can be queried.

abort.no_available_devices: All AC devices on this account are already configured.

command_not_confirmed.title: TCL AC command was not confirmed
command_not_confirmed.description: Home Assistant sent a command to the TCL air conditioner, but the device did not report the expected state within the confirmation timeout. Check local UDP reachability, TCL+ cloud fallback, and whether the command is supported by this model.

init.description: Update local UDP, TCL+ cloud, and experimental mode settings. Keep Fan Only and Auto/AI disabled until live mode tests confirm support on this device.

data.enable_fan_only_mode: Enable experimental Fan Only HVAC mode
